description: 🚀 Team BlackCat is a group of passionate tech enthusiasts participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 at Harohalli. We're building an innovative solution for wildfire monitoring using NASA's MODIS and VIIRS satellite data. We're looking for enthusiastic teammates skilled in coding, Python, AI/ML, data science, GIS, UI/UX and research. Join us to turn space data into real-world impact! 🌍🔥
